title: Higher order double point formulas via SSM-Thom polynomials
summary: We study the geometry of double point loci of maps $F:M\to N$ of complex manifolds through the lens of Segre-Schwartz-MacPherson (SSM) classes. Classical double point formulas express the fundamental class of the closure of the double point locus of $F$ in terms of global invariants of source and target spaces, as well as $F$. In this paper we extend these results by computing a one-parameter cohomological deformation of the double point formula given by the SSM class.
